purpose: Fresh independent OpenAI Compose reserve B, October 2. Freeze and commit after reserve A repairs, before export or generation.

semanticCriteria.gate: At least 19 of 20 useful review-ready drafts; zero critical changes to meaning, recipients, exact words, restrictions, uncertainty, privacy or writing-direction separation. A rejected draft is not useful.
semanticCriteria.critical: Changed or invented operative facts, dropped recipient or condition, changed exact literal, a consumed writer instruction in the message, an invented task, disclosed excluded reason or claimed execution.
semanticCriteria.minor: Faithful stylistic paraphrase, capitalization outside exact text, punctuation or list formatting that retains all operative meaning.
semanticCriteria.review: Grade the first model outputs using frozen per-case criteria and production output guards. Preserve failures; do not tune or rerun before grading.

cases.spoken: Have you received the attachment I sent? Please make this professional.
cases.exampleDraft: Have you received the attachment I sent?
cases.completionCriteria: Receipt question remains receipt, not reading or approval; no unsolicited task.

cases.spoken: Tell Rosa I can send the agenda on Saturday, but I cannot promise a final budget yet. Make this shorter.
cases.exampleDraft: Rosa, I can send the agenda Saturday, but cannot promise a final budget yet.
cases.completionCriteria: Rosa, ability not promise, Saturday, explicit budget boundary.

cases.spoken: I believe the missing row is a duplicate, but I am uncertain. Could you check before deleting it? Make this professional.
cases.exampleDraft: I believe the missing row is a duplicate, but I am uncertain. Could you check before deleting it?
cases.completionCriteria: Both belief and knowledge qualifiers, duplicate hypothesis, check before deletion.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Omar with the exact words "Keep the original receipt".
cases.exampleDraft: Omar, Keep the original receipt
cases.completionCriteria: Omar and exact body; no use-these-words direction.

cases.spoken: Tell Leah I cannot join the workshop on Friday because I have an appointment. Do not mention the reason.
cases.exampleDraft: Leah, I cannot join the workshop on Friday.
cases.completionCriteria: Leah, cannot join workshop Friday; omit appointment and writer direction.

cases.spoken: Tell Tessa the call starts at 10 AM. Correction, it starts at 11 AM. Ask if she can make it.
cases.exampleDraft: Tessa, the call starts at 11 AM. Can you make it?
cases.completionCriteria: Tessa, only 11 AM, availability question; omit superseded 10 AM.

cases.spoken: Ask Yusuf to make the summary shorter but leave the legal wording unchanged.
cases.exampleDraft: Yusuf, please shorten the summary but leave the legal wording unchanged.
cases.completionCriteria: Yusuf; recipient editing task and exact preservation restriction remain.

cases.spoken: Ask Claude to inspect `app/Queue.swift` with --verbose. Do not alter files or create a commit.
cases.exampleDraft: Inspect app/Queue.swift with --verbose. Do not alter files or create a commit.
cases.completionCriteria: Direct task, path, flag, both negative action constraints; no claimed work.

cases.spoken: Write two bullets: the download finished; the import is not finished.
cases.exampleDraft:
- The download finished.
- The import is not finished.
cases.completionCriteria: Exactly two bullets, distinguish positive download from negative import.

cases.spoken: Tell Sienna the parcel has been dispatched, but delivery has not been confirmed.
cases.exampleDraft: Sienna, the parcel has been dispatched, but delivery has not been confirmed.
cases.completionCriteria: Sienna; dispatched not delivered; unconfirmed delivery retained.

cases.spoken: Ask Marco whether 4 PM ET on Thursday works, or if Friday is easier.
cases.exampleDraft: Marco, does 4 PM ET on Thursday work, or is Friday easier?
cases.completionCriteria: Marco, 4 PM ET, Thursday and Friday alternatives, no firm appointment.

cases.spoken: The charge is $62 per device per year, not $62 for all devices.
cases.exampleDraft: The charge is $62 per device per year, not $62 for all devices.
cases.completionCriteria: Amount, device unit, yearly period, explicit negative total contrast.

cases.spoken: Write a note to Ada containing the exact words "Do not shorten this sentence".
cases.exampleDraft: Ada, Do not shorten this sentence
cases.completionCriteria: Ada and exact command-like body retained as recipient content.

cases.spoken: Ask Theo if he can look at the photo after dinner. Make it casual.
cases.exampleDraft: Theo, can you look at the photo after dinner?
cases.completionCriteria: Theo, permissive question, photo, after dinner; no new task or deadline.

cases.spoken: I might be wrong, but I think the connection dropped before the timeout. Write this as a reply in Codex.
cases.exampleDraft: I might be wrong, but I think the connection dropped before the timeout.
cases.completionCriteria: Uncertain statement remains reply, temporal relation retained; no invented investigation.

cases.spoken: Tell Mei payment INV-208 is pending, and no confirmation has arrived.
cases.exampleDraft: Mei, payment INV-208 is pending and no confirmation has arrived.
cases.completionCriteria: Mei, exact ID, pending status, no confirmation or claim of payment.

cases.spoken: I can prepare the outline, but I cannot approve the spending. Could you review it? Write this professionally.
cases.exampleDraft: I can prepare the outline, but I cannot approve the spending. Could you review it?
cases.completionCriteria: Ability not promise, approval boundary, recipient review question.

cases.spoken: Tell Owen I can help with one section this month, but not the full report. Keep it concise.
cases.exampleDraft: Owen, I can help with one section this month, but not the full report.
cases.completionCriteria: Owen, one section, this month, full-report exclusion and ability.

cases.spoken: Tell Nina I appreciate her patience while the documents are checked. Make this warm.
cases.exampleDraft: Nina, I really appreciate your patience while the documents are checked.
cases.completionCriteria: Nina, appreciation, ongoing document check, no completion implied.

cases.spoken: Tell Hugo the quote is $180, but I have not accepted it.
cases.exampleDraft: Hugo, the quote is $180, but I have not accepted it.
cases.completionCriteria: Hugo, amount, explicit nonacceptance; no agreement or payment.
